title: [Nekomoe kissaten&Airota&VCB-Studio] Omiai Aite wa Oshiego, Tsuyoki na, Mondaiji. / お見合い相手は教え子、強気な、問題児。 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
description:
![Omitsuyo_1_800.webp](https://img.2222.moe/images/2022/11/26/Omitsuyo_1_800.webp)
  
相亲对象是自己的学生，强势的问题儿童。 BDRip
Omiai Aite wa Oshiego, Tsuyoki na, Mondaiji. BDRip
お見合い相手は教え子、強気な、問題児。 BDRip
10-bit 1080p HEVC + FLAC，MKV 格式。每话约 160 MB。
10-bit 1080p HEVC + FLAC, MKV format. ~ 160 MB / EP.

这个项目与 **喵萌奶茶屋** 和 **千夏字幕组** 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in cooperation with **Nekomoe kissaten** and **Airota**. Thanks to them for elaborating Chinese subtitles.

仅包含 R18 版本，不含 TV Ver. 和 CS Ver.
Includes R18 version only, no TV Ver. or CS Ver.

原盘画质一般。原生分辨率为 810p，线条有轻微的锯齿和振铃。原盘视频轨道码率看上去是 30Mbps，但我们 remux 之后发现实际上约为 22 Mbps。码率较低再加上制作时缺乏保护，导致平面有较严重的色带。我们的处理手段是逆向拉伸重构、自适应去色带、补偿性锐化，最后加了一些噪点以改善观感。
The source is average, produced in native 810p. Lines feature slight aliasing and ringing. The video tracks of the source seem to have a bitrate of 30Mbps, though actually 22Mbps after remux. Low bitrate plus the lack of image protection during production leads to severe colour banding in the flat area. Our PP: descaling and reconstruction, adaptive de-banding, compensatory sharpening and adding some grains in the end to improve the viewing experience.
